title: Get Authorized Trading Accounts
description: Query the authorized trading accounts of uid.

title: Query Max Tradable Quantity
description: Query the maximum quantity that can be bought or sold under a specific trading account, and you can also query the maximum changeable quantity of a specific order.

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Trading business account ID.

params.name: code
params.description: Symbol code. Format: exchange.symbol, e.g. US.AAPL

params.name: price
params.description: Price of a non-market order. For securities accounts, accurate to 3 decimal places. For futures accounts, accurate to 9 decimal places. Excess will be discarded.

params.name: order_type
params.description: Order type. See Naming Dictionary

params.name: order_id
params.description: Order ID. By default, using empty string to query the maximum available quantity for new orders. If an order needs modifying, the order_id needs to be transmitted. If you use this parameter to query the maximum quantity, you need to call this interface again after placing an order, with an interval of more than 0.5 seconds.

title: Get Historical Deals
description: Query the historical transaction list of the specified trading business account.

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Trading business account ID.

params.name: trd_market
params.description: Trading market. See Naming Dictionary

params.name: code
params.description: Code filtering. Return the data of the specified code. By default, return all data.

params.name: start
params.description: Start time of update time. Timestamp, in microseconds.

params.name: end
params.description: End time of update time, which should be after start time. Timestamp, in microseconds.

params.name: page_flag
params.description: Empty string, which means starting from the beginning, otherwise using the page_flag returned by the server.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Page size. Default is 50. Range: 10-50.

title: Get Account Funds
description: Query the net asset value, securities market value, cash, purchasing power and other fund data of the trading business account.

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Trading business account ID.

params.name: currency
params.description: Display currency of funds. Only applicable to futures accounts and comprehensive securities accounts; this parameter will be ignored for other account types. In the returned data, except for fields that clearly indicate the currency, other fund-related fields are converted with this parameter.

title: Order Confirm
description: Confirm an order. This endpoint needs to be called when need_order_confirm is returned as true after placing or modifying an order.

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Business account ID.

params.name: confirm_id
params.description: Order confirm ID, from the confirm_id of place order or modify order response.

title: Get Today's Deals
description: Query the daily transaction list of the specified trading business account.

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Trading business account ID.

params.name: trd_market
params.description: Trading market. See Naming Dictionary

params.name: page_flag
params.description: Empty string, which means starting from the beginning, otherwise using the page_flag returned by the server.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Page size. Default is 50. Range: 10-100.

title: Get Open Orders
description: Query the list of open orders for a specified account.

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Trading business account ID.

params.name: trd_market
params.description: Trading market. See Naming Dictionary

params.name: page_flag
params.description: Empty string, which means starting from the beginning, otherwise using the page_flag returned by the server.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Page size. Default is 50. Range: 10-100.

title: Place Order
description: Place a new order.

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Business account ID.

params.name: code
params.description: Tradable symbol. Format: exchange.symbol, e.g. US.AAPL, US.AAPL250926C235000

params.name: qty
params.description: Order quantity. The unit of options and futures is "contract".

params.name: price
params.description: Order price. 4 decimal place accuracy (9 for futures), excess part will be rounded.

params.name: side
params.description: Trading direction. Values: BUY, SELL, SELL_SHORT, BUY_BACK

params.name: order_type
params.description: Order type. Values: LIMIT, MARKET, AUCTION, AUCTION_LIMIT, STOP, STOP_LIMIT, MARKET_IF_TOUCHED, LIMIT_IF_TOUCHED

params.name: time_in_force
params.description: Valid period. Values: DAY (good for the day), GTC (good until cancel)

params.name: session
params.description: Trading session (US stocks only). Values: RTH (regular trading hours), RTH+Pre/Post-Mkt, OVERNIGHT (night trading only), ALL_DAY. Market orders only support RTH.

params.name: aux_price
params.description: Trigger price. Required when order type is STOP, STOP_LIMIT, MARKET_IF_TOUCHED, or LIMIT_IF_TOUCHED. The price will be rounded to 3 decimals for securities account, and 9 decimals for futures account.

params.name: lot_type
params.description: Lot type, default round lot. Used for HK stock trading.

params.name: remark
params.description: Remark. Maximum length after converting to UTF-8 is 64 bytes.

params.name: order_class
params.description: Order class. Specify as MLEG for multi-leg orders.

params.name: multi_leg_info
params.description: Multi-leg order info. Required when placing multi-leg orders.

title: Get Order Details
description: Query the details of specified orders.

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Trading business account ID.

params.name: exchange
params.description: Exchange. If querying multiple orders, these orders must be in the same exchange. See Naming Dictionary

params.name: order_ids
params.description: Order ID list. The length of order_ids should be less than 50.

title: Cancel Order
description: Cancel an existing order.

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Business account ID.

params.name: order_id
params.description: Order ID.

params.name: exchange
params.description: Exchange. See Naming Dictionary - exchange.

title: Modify Order
description: Modify an existing order.

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Business account ID.

params.name: order_id
params.description: Order ID.

params.name: exchange
params.description: Exchange. See Naming Dictionary - exchange.

params.name: qty
params.description: The quantity after the order is changed. The unit of options and futures is "contract".

params.name: price
params.description: The price after the order is changed. 9 decimal places for futures, 4 for others; excess is discarded.

params.name: aux_price
params.description: Trigger price. Required when order type is STOP, STOP_LIMIT, MARKET_IF_TOUCHED, or LIMIT_IF_TOUCHED. The price will be rounded to 3 decimals for securities account, and 9 decimals for futures account.

title: Get Historical Orders
description: Query the historical order list of the specified trading business account.

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Trading business account ID.

params.name: trd_market
params.description: Trading market. See Naming Dictionary

params.name: code
params.description: Code filtering. Return the data of the specified code. By default, return all data.

params.name: start
params.description: Start time of create time. Timestamp, in microseconds.

params.name: end
params.description: End time of create time, which should be after start time. Timestamp, in microseconds.

params.name: page_flag
params.description: Empty string, which means starting from the beginning, otherwise using the page_flag returned by the server.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Page size. Default is 50. Range: 10-100.

title: Get Positions
description: Query the holding position list of a specific trading account.

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Trading business account ID.

params.name: code
params.description: Only return positions matching these codes. If not passed, return all. For futures positions, you need to pass the contract code with a specific month; filtering by the main contract code is not supported.

params.name: pl_ratio_min
params.description: Lower limit of current P&L ratio filter. e.g. When 10 is passed, positions with P&L ratio ≥ +10% will be returned.

params.name: pl_ratio_max
params.description: Upper limit of current P&L ratio filter. e.g. When 20 is passed, positions with P&L ratio ≤ +20% will be returned.

title: Combo Option Quote
description: Quote combo option packages using caller-supplied legs (contract + BUY/SELL + quantity).

params.name: combo_list
params.description: Combo list, 1~20 items. Each element is described below.

params.name: legs
params.description: Legs of this combo, at least 1.

params.name: code
params.description: US or HK option contract, or the underlying stock for Covered. Option e.g. US.AAPL260821C110000; Covered adds US.AAPL BUY 100. At most one stock leg per combo.

params.name: side
params.description: Trade side. See Naming Dictionary.

params.name: quantity
params.description: Quantity, a positive integer.

title: Economic Calendar Hot
description: Get a list of hot/recommended economic data for a specific date (sorted by importance). Returns major economic indicators scheduled for that day (e.g. CPI, GDP, non-farm payrolls, central bank rate decisions), including previous value, forecast, actual value, and importance star rating.

params.name: limit
params.description: Items per page, range 1~20

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor; leave empty for first page, pass previous pagination.next_key to continue

params.name: date
params.description: Query date, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20260618

params.name: timezone
params.description: Timezone for the date, e.g. America/New_York

title: Economic Calendar Search
description: Search the economic calendar by keyword, supporting four types: economic data (CPI/GDP/non-farm payrolls and other macro indicators), market closures, economic events (central bank speeches/meetings), and corporate actions (dividends/splits). Returns matching event list with pagination and time sorting.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Search keyword, e.g. CPI, Fed, GDP

params.name: search_type
params.description: Search type, see enum table below

params.name: limit
params.description: Items per page, range 1~30

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor; leave empty for first page, pass previous pagination.next_key to continue

params.name: time_order_type
params.description: Sort order: 0=ascending (ASC), 1=descending (DESC); only applies when search_type=2/3

title: find-community
description: Search community discussions, topics, and live streams by keyword.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Search keyword

params.name: size
params.description: Number of results, default 10, range 1~50

params.name: community_type
params.description: Community type: 1=Discussion(FEED), 2=Topic(TOPIC), 3=Live(LIVE); omit for all

params.name: sort_type
params.description: Sort: 1=by popularity, 2=by time (latest); omit for backend default

params.name: lang
params.description: Language filter: zh-CN / zh-HK / en / ja

title: find-news
description: Search news articles, announcements, and research reports by keyword.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Search keyword, e.g. Tencent, AAPL, new energy

params.name: size
params.description: Number of results, default 10, range 1~50

params.name: news_type
params.description: News type filter: 1=News(POST), 2=Announcement(NOTICE), 3=Report(REPORT); omit to return all

params.name: sort_type
params.description: Sort: 1=by reads, 2=by time (latest); omit for backend default

params.name: lang
params.description: Language filter: zh-CN / zh-HK / en / ja

title: Future Info
description: Get basic information for futures contracts (exchange, trade time, contract size, price unit, min change, etc.).

params.name: code_list
params.description: Futures contract code list, max 400 per request; e.g. ["HK.HSImain", "US.CLmain"].

title: IPO List
description: Get the new stock IPO list. Supports Hong Kong / US / A-shares / Singapore / Malaysia — five markets, each with a separate endpoint. Returns recent subscribable and upcoming IPOs, excluding historical IPOs.

params.name: market
params.description: Path parameter market.

title: Market State
description: Get the current market state (open / closed / pre-market / after-hours / overnight / closing auction, etc.) for a batch of symbols. Useful for determining quote availability and freshness.

params.name: code_list
params.description: List of symbol codes in {market}.{code} format, e.g. ["HK.00700","US.AAPL","SH.600519"]. Market prefix is required. Max 400 per batch.

params.name: is_contain_ba
params.description: Whether to include US pre-market/after-hours sessions; true switches trade_section to the next trading day's schedule once pre/after-hours begins. Default false. Only affects US-related entries.

params.name: is_contain_overnight
params.description: Whether to include US overnight session; true switches trade_section to the next trading day's schedule once overnight begins. Default false. Only affects US-related entries.

params.name: is_need_crypto_multi_broker
params.description: Whether to return multi-broker data for crypto market; true expands multiple records per market_id by broker. Default false. Only affects CC. prefix entries.

title: Modify User Security
description: Modify user watchlist: add symbols to a group, remove from a specific group only, or delete from all groups entirely. Use user-security-group to query watchlist groups; use user-security to query symbols in a group.

params.name: group_name
params.description: Watchlist group name (first match if duplicate names), max 100 characters; only custom groups supported. Required for op=ADD/MOVE_OUT; optional for op=DEL.

params.name: op
params.description: Operation type: ADD=add to specified group / DEL=delete from all groups entirely / MOVE_OUT=remove from specified group only.

params.name: code_list
params.description: List of symbol codes, must not be empty, 1-200 per call. e.g. ["HK.00700","US.AAPL"].

title: Option Screen
description: Option screener: within a specified market category (US/HK/JP stocks x stocks/indices/futures), filter option contracts from the entire market using multi-group conditions expressed by strategy (underlying, strike price, expiration date, option direction, Greeks, implied volatility, chain statistics, etc.). Supports sorting and pagination.

params.name: strategy
params.description: Screening strategy. Structure: {market_category_list, filter_group_list}. market_category_list values: 0=US_STOCK / 1=US_INDEX / 2=US_FUTURE / 3=HK_STOCK / 4=HK_INDEX / 5=JP_STOCK / 6=JP_INDEX (multiple elements form a union). filter_group_list multiple groups intersect; within a single group, same-field indicator arrays form a union; each group must have exactly one non-empty list among underlying_list / option_list / chain_list / combo_list.

params.name: strategy_param
params.description: Strategy additional parameters. Required only when the strategy uses watchlist or stock screener results as underlying source: watch_stock_id_list:[uint64] / stock_screener_stock_id_list:[uint64].

params.name: field_filter
params.description: Declare which indicator fields to return. When not provided, only the default 4 fields (volume / price / chg_ratio / implied_volatility) + option_id are returned. Use 1 as placeholder for int fields, string placeholder (e.g. "x") for string fields. Nested fields use proto field names, e.g. underlying_info:{iv:1, hv:1}.

params.name: sort_obj
params.description: Sort method: {sort_field: OptionItem, is_asc}. sort_field sets only 1 field (e.g. {"volume":1}). is_asc non-zero for ascending, 0/omit for descending. Default: by volume descending.

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for first page; pass back previous page's pagination.next_key.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size. Default 100, max 1000; can pass 0 (query total count only, used with request_exact_data=0).

params.name: request_exact_data
params.description: Whether to return exact detail: 0=return total count only (option_list is empty), 1=return detail list (default).

title: Order Book
description: Get real-time bid/ask order book for a symbol. The number of levels and book shape are determined jointly by the user's market data permission level (LV1/LV2/LV3) and category; the gateway automatically selects the fetch method and level count based on permissions.

params.name: code
params.description: Symbol code, format <MARKET>.<SYMBOL>, e.g. HK.00700.

params.name: num
params.description: Maximum number of price levels to return, range 1~60; if not provided, returns the maximum levels allowed by the user's permission.

title: Plate List
description: Get all plates (sectors) under a specified market and plate class.

params.name: market
params.description: Market prefix. See Naming Dictionary.

params.name: plate_class
params.description: Plate class: ALL / INDUSTRY / REGION / CONCEPT / OTHER. See Naming Dictionary.

title: Plate Stock
description: Get the list of stock members under a specified plate (sector), with sorting and pagination support.

params.name: plate_code
params.description: Plate code (from the plate list API), e.g. HK.LIST1045.

params.name: sort_field
params.description: Sort field. Default NONE. See Naming Dictionary.

params.name: ascend
params.description: Ascending order. Default true.

params.name: price_type
params.description: Value source for price-type sort fields. Default NORMAL. Values: NORMAL / BEFORE / AFTER / OVERNIGHT.

params.name: leverage_direction
params.description: ETF leverage direction filter (only effective for ETF plates): 0=all / 1=long / 2=short. Default 0.

params.name: leverage_multiple
params.description: ETF leverage multiple filter (only effective for ETF plates), scaled by 10^3, e.g. 2000=2x. Default 0=all.

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; pass the previous page's pagination.next_key.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size. Default 200, max 1000.

title: Market Snapshot
description: Batch get real-time market snapshot for up to 400 symbols. Returns common fields (last/open/high/low/prev close, volume, turnover, turnover rate, etc.), financial fields (market cap, PE, PB, EPS, dividend yield, etc.) and category-specific fields (index component counts, futures settlement, options greeks, etc.).

params.name: code_list
params.description: List of symbol codes (min 1, max 400). Format: <MARKET>.<CODE>, e.g. HK.09988, US.AAPL, BMD.FCPOmain.

title: Stock Basic Info
description: Get basic static information for stocks (listing date, lot size, stock type, etc.).

params.name: code_list
params.description: List of symbol codes, 1-400 per request, e.g. ["HK.00700","US.AAPL"]

title: Stock Quote
description: Batch get real-time stock quotes (lightweight snapshot), aligned with the Quote base quote pushed via subscription. Compared to get_market_snapshot, the field set is more compact and suitable for multi-symbol polling.

params.name: code_list
params.description: List of symbol codes.

title: Stock Screen
description: Conditional stock screening: combine N filter conditions to filter, sort, and paginate across the entire market, returning multiple columns for each matched security based on specified retrieval factors. For warrant screening use warrant-screen; for option screening use option-screen.

params.name: screen_queries
params.description: Filter condition array. Each element is a "1-of-11" query object -- simple_field_query (market/exchange/index/northbound sector enum field IN list) / plate_query (plate filter) / simple_property_query (quote/valuation factor range) / cumulative_property_query (cumulative quote range, requires period) / financial_property_query (financial factor range, requires fiscal period) / indicator_positional_query (technical indicator positional relationship) / indicator_pattern_query (technical pattern) / featured_property_query (featured factor) / broker_holdings_query (broker holdings, HK only) / kline_shape_query (K-line pattern) / option_query (option indicator). Ranges use lower={value, includes} / upper={value, includes}, where value is pre-multiplied by the field's multiplier.

params.name: retrieve_queries
params.description: Retrieval factor array. Each element is a "1-of-9" retrieve object -- basic_property / simple_property / cumulative_property / financial_property / featured_property / indicator_property / broker_property / kline_shape_property / option_property. Return order aligns exactly with retrieve_queries.

params.name: sort
params.description: Single-field sort (mutually exclusive with sorts; sorts takes priority). Structure: {direction, simple_property:{name}} (can also use cumulative_property / financial_property / featured_property). direction: 1=ASC, 2=DESC, 3=ASC by absolute value, 4=DESC by absolute value.

params.name: sorts
params.description: Multi-field sort, priority by array order. Each element has the same structure as sort.

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; pass back the previous page's pagination.next_key.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size. Default 200, max 300.

params.name: watchlist_stock_ids
params.description: Watchlist stock_id list. Used with user_stock_list_mode=1 to screen within watchlist scope.

params.name: holding_stock_ids
params.description: Holdings stock_id list. Used with user_stock_list_mode=2 to screen within holdings scope.

params.name: user_stock_list_mode
params.description: User stock list filter mode: 0=unrestricted (default) / 1=watchlist only / 2=holdings only.

title: Trading Days
description: Get the trading calendar for a specified market within a date range.

params.name: market
params.description: Market code, e.g. HK, US, SH. See Naming Dictionary.

params.name: start
params.description: Start date (yyyy-MM-dd).

params.name: end
params.description: End date (yyyy-MM-dd).

title: Get User Security
description: Get the watchlist (user security list) for a specified group. Returns each security's code, name, lot size, security type, and derivative information.

params.name: group_name
params.description: Group name (URL-encoded), max 100 characters. Group names can be obtained from user-security-group.

title: Get User Security Group
description: Get the user's watchlist group list (including system preset groups and user custom groups). Use user-security to get symbols in a group; use modify-user-security to add/remove symbols.

params.name: group_type
params.description: Group type filter. Default ALL. Values: ALL=all / SYSTEM=system preset / CUSTOM=user custom.

title: Index Related Plates
description: Get plates related to an index; usable as filter_security candidates for index constituent valuation.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Index symbol, e.g. HK.800000.

title: Index Component Valuation
description: Get valuation list of index constituents, with pagination, sorting and optional plate filter.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Index symbol, e.g. HK.800000 (HSI).

params.name: valuation_type
params.description: Valuation type. Default 1. 1=PE, 2=PB, 3=PS.

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for first page.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size. Default 10, max 50.

params.name: sort_type
params.description: Sort direction. Same as plate valuation API.

params.name: sort_id
params.description: Sort field. Same as plate valuation API.

params.name: filter_security
params.description: Filter index constituents by plate; leave empty for no filter. Use index-stock-plates API for candidates.

title: Valuation Plate Stocks
description: Get the constituent stock list for a plate with valuation data, supporting pagination by valuation type, sort field and direction.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Industry plate code, e.g. HK.LIST1003.

params.name: valuation_type
params.description: Valuation type. Default 1. 1=PE, 2=PB, 3=PS.

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor, leave empty for first page.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size. Default 10, max 50.

params.name: sort_type
params.description: Sort direction. Default asc. asc=ascending, desc=descending.

params.name: sort_id
params.description: Sort field. Default market_cap. Options: market_cap / valuation / forward_valuation / historical_percentile.

title: Warrant Screen
description: Warrant screening -- filter within the warrant market (CALL warrants / PUT warrants / BULL CBBCs / BEAR CBBCs / INLINE warrants) by combining dimensions such as issuer, underlying, price, strike price, maturity date, street ratio, implied volatility, leverage, delta, warrant status, etc. Supports multi-level sorting and pagination.

params.name: market_type
params.description: Default 1 (HK). Allowed values: 1=HK (Hong Kong), 4=SG (Singapore), 15=MY (Malaysia).

params.name: is_delay
params.description: Whether to use delayed data. Default false.

params.name: only_count
params.description: Return count only without detail list. Default false.

params.name: stock_owner
params.description: Underlying code (convenience parameter, auto-converted to a single screen_groups condition, e.g. HK.00700). Use screen_groups for complex filtering.

params.name: screen_groups
params.description: Filter condition list. Each element structure: {field_id, interval{lower{value,is_included}, upper{value,is_included}}, choices[{content_type, value}]}. Discrete selection uses choices (multiple elements = OR); range filtering uses interval. See the wrnt_field enum table below for field_id values.

params.name: sorts
params.description: Sort condition list. Each element: {sort_field_id, sort_flag}. sort_flag=true for descending, false for ascending.

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for first page; pass back previous page's pagination.next_key.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size. Default 200, max 1000.

title: Capital Distribution
description: Get the current day's capital flow distribution by order size (super-large, large, medium, small) for an individual stock.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. SZ.000001.

title: Capital Flow (Intraday)
description: Get intraday (minute-level) capital flow in/out data for an individual stock.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, MARKET.CODE format, e.g. HK.00700 / US.AAPL / SZ.000001.

params.name: section
params.description: Trading session, default NORMAL. See Naming Dictionary.

title: Capital Flow (History)
description: Get historical capital flow in/out data at day/week/month level for an individual stock.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, MARKET.CODE format, e.g. HK.00700 / US.AAPL / SZ.000001.

params.name: period_type
params.description: Aggregation period, default DAY. See Naming Dictionary.

params.name: start
params.description: Start date yyyy-MM-dd (inclusive), omit for no lower bound.

params.name: end
params.description: End date yyyy-MM-dd (inclusive), omit to use current date.

params.name: count
params.description: Maximum number of data points to return, range 1~1000, default 365.

title: Executive Background
description: Get detailed background information for a specific executive. You must first obtain the leader_name from the Company Executives API, then pass it to this API to query a single executive's long-text background profile.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

params.name: leader_name
params.description: Executive name, must exactly match the leader_name field returned by the Company Executives API.

title: Company Executives
description: Get the list of company executives (directors / management) and their basic appointment information: name, position, gender, age, appointment start date, highest education, shares held, annual salary.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

title: Operational Efficiency
description: Get historical operational efficiency metrics for a company (employee count, revenue per capita / operating profit per capita / net profit per capita and their respective YoY), returned by financial reporting period.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of records. Default 10, max 100.

params.name: financial_type
params.description: Default 7. Options: 7 (annual report) / 102 (all cumulative quarterly reports). See Naming Dictionary.

params.name: currency_code
params.description: Currency code (ISO 4217), e.g. CNY. Defaults to the currency of the latest report.

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor; leave empty for the first page.

title: Company Profile
description: Get company detail labels (company overview, listing info, key metrics, etc.) displayed in a "label name / label value" format. ETF / REIT automatically routes to fund data source.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

title: Buybacks
description: Get the share buyback history for a company. Returns HK or A-share data depending on the market of the symbol.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor; leave empty for the first page.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size. Default 10, max 50.

title: Dividends
description: Get the dividend payment history for a stock (sorted by time descending, max 100 records). Each record returns fiscal year, plan description, cash dividend per share with currency, payout ratio, dividend type, plan progress, and key dates.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

title: Rehabilitation Factor
description: Get the adjustment (rehabilitation) factors for a stock, including forward/backward adjustment factors, dividend, split, and allotment ratios.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700 / US.AAPL

params.name: divi_mode
params.description: Dividend handling mode for adjustment factors. See Naming Dictionary > divi_mode

title: Stock Splits
description: Get detailed records of HK stock split/consolidation events (split / consolidation / consolidation-then-split / split-then-consolidation). Only HK market is supported.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code (HK stocks only have data), e.g. HK.00700.

title: Current K-Line
description: Get real-time K-line (candlestick) data for a symbol, returning the latest num bars. Supports minute/day/week/month/year/quarter periods and adjustment types. Only returns the latest N bars.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

params.name: num
params.description: Number of K-line bars, 1~370.

params.name: ktype
params.description: K-line type, default 2. See ktype enum table below.

params.name: autype
params.description: Adjustment type, default 1. See autype enum table below.

params.name: extended_time
params.description: Pre/post market / night session toggle, default 0 (only effective for US 1-min K-line). See extended_time enum table below.

title: Earnings Price History
description: Get the stock price performance on historical earnings release dates and surrounding offset days. Each earnings period returns: option predicted volatility, post-earnings IV crush, OHLC for the earnings trading day, and a daily close price series from -15 to +14 days centered on the disclosure date.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

title: Earnings Price Move
description: Get the stock price movement around earnings disclosure dates. Returns daily quote sequences centered on the disclosure date across multiple reporting periods (open/close/high/low/previous close/volume, option IV/HV), along with an overview summary for the entire request (average earnings-day price change over recent N periods).

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of recent earnings periods to return. Default 10, max 50.

params.name: overview_count
params.description: Number of earnings periods for overview statistics. Default 8, max 50. Effective value = min(overview_count, count).

title: Revenue Breakdown
description: Get a company's revenue composition breakdown by product / industry / region / business dimension for a specified financial period, along with an available period dropdown list.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

params.name: date
params.description: Financial period end date (second-level timestamp); 0 = latest period. Default 0.

params.name: financial_type
params.description: Financial period type selector. Default 0. See Naming Dictionary.

params.name: currency_code
params.description: Currency code (ISO 4217), e.g. USD. If not provided, returns in the original report currency.

title: Financial Statements
description: Get the income statement / balance sheet / cash flow statement / key metrics data for a company, returned by reporting period. Each record includes report period, fiscal year, financial period type, currency and accounting standards, as well as item_list (each field contains field_id, English field name display_name, value, YoY, QoQ).

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

params.name: statement_type
params.description: Report type. Default 1. 1=Income Statement, 2=Balance Sheet, 3=Cash Flow Statement, 4=Key Metrics.

params.name: financial_type
params.description: Financial period type. Default 10. See Naming Dictionary.

params.name: currency_code
params.description: Currency code (ISO 4217), e.g. CNY, USD. Default is the report's native currency.

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for first page; pass the pagination.next_key from last response for next page.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size. Default 10, max 50.

title: History K-Line
description: Get historical K-line (candlestick) data with pagination support.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. US.FUTU.

params.name: start
params.description: Start date (yyyy-MM-dd).

params.name: end
params.description: End date (yyyy-MM-dd).

params.name: ktype
params.description: K-line type. Default 2. 1=1min, 2=Day, 3=Week, 4=Month, 5=Year, 6=5min, 7=15min, 8=30min, 9=60min. See Naming Dictionary.

params.name: autype
params.description: Adjustment type. Default 1. 0=None, 1=Forward, 2=Backward. See Naming Dictionary.

params.name: num
params.description: Number of bars. Default 370, max 370.

params.name: extended_time
params.description: Extended hours. Default 0. 0=Default, 1=Include pre/after market (US minute K), 2=Include overnight (US). See Naming Dictionary.

title: Option Chain
description: Get the option chain for a given underlying symbol within a specified expiration date range. For US combo lists / spreads / quotes use Combo Option Strategy, Combo Option Spread, and Combo Option Quote.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Option underlying code, e.g. HK.00700, US.AAPL, HK.800000 (HSI).

params.name: start
params.description: Start expiration date yyyy-MM-dd (inclusive), omit for no lower bound.

params.name: end
params.description: End expiration date yyyy-MM-dd (inclusive), omit for no upper bound.

params.name: index_option_type
params.description: Index option type, required only for index underlyings, omit for regular stocks. See Naming Dictionary.

params.name: filter_standard
params.description: Filter by standard/non-standard options, default ALL. See Naming Dictionary.

title: Option Exercise Probability
description: Get the exercise probability analysis for an option contract.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Option contract code (must be an option contract, not an underlying stock code), e.g. HK.TCH260528C230000.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return, range 1~1000; omit to return full history for the contract.

title: Option Expiration Date
description: Get the list of option expiration dates for a given underlying symbol. For US combo options, take strike_time from this API as expire_time / far_expire_time, then call Combo Option Strategy.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Option underlying code, e.g. HK.00700, US.AAPL, HK.800000 (HSI).

params.name: index_option_type
params.description: Index option type, required only for index underlyings, omit for regular stocks. See Naming Dictionary.

params.name: filter_standard
params.description: Filter by standard/non-standard, default ALL. See Naming Dictionary.

params.name: filter_expiration_cycles
params.description: Filter by expiration cycle, comma-separated (e.g. MONTH,QUARTERLY), omit or empty string = no filter. See Naming Dictionary.

title: Combo Option Strategy
description: Query combo option lists by underlying, strategy type and expiry date. Returns combo_list[]: each item is one combo, with all legs in legs[] (instrument=OPTION for option contracts; Covered/Collar also include the path underlying as instrument=STOCK).

params.name: symbol
params.description: Option underlying code, US or HK equity/ETF. e.g. US.AAPL / HK.00700.

params.name: strategy
params.description: Combo strategy type. See Naming Dictionary. HK does not support Covered(2) / Collar(8).

params.name: expire_time
params.description: Near expiry date yyyy-MM-dd, e.g. 2026-08-21.

params.name: far_expire_time
params.description: Far expiry date yyyy-MM-dd. Required for CalendarSpread(15) / DiagonalSpread(16), and must be later than expire_time.

params.name: spread
params.description: Spread in real price (0~9223372036). Required for 4/7/8/9/11/13/14/16; omitting it returns -5. Call Combo Option Spread first and pass default_spread or a spread_list value. Optional for 1/2/6/15/100. See Naming Dictionary.

params.name: index_option_type
params.description: US index option type; required only for US index underlyings, omit for equities. Use the US block (1000+) in the Naming Dictionary.

params.name: filter_standard
params.description: Filter by standard/non-standard, default ALL. See Naming Dictionary.

title: Combo Option Spread
description: Query the backend spread list and default spread for an underlying + strategy + expiry. Returns spread_list (already restored to real prices) and default_spread.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Option underlying code, US only. e.g. US.AAPL.

params.name: strategy
params.description: Combo strategy type. See Naming Dictionary.

params.name: expire_time
params.description: Near expiry date yyyy-MM-dd, e.g. 2026-08-21.

params.name: far_expire_time
params.description: Far expiry date yyyy-MM-dd. Required for CalendarSpread(15) / DiagonalSpread(16), and must be later than expire_time.

params.name: index_option_type
params.description: US index option type; required only for US index underlyings. Use the US block (1000+) in the Naming Dictionary.

params.name: filter_standard
params.description: Filter by standard/non-standard, default ALL. See Naming Dictionary.

title: Option Volatility
description: Get implied volatility (IV), historical volatility (HV), volatility premium analysis and text analysis for an option contract.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Option contract code (must be an option contract, not an underlying stock code), e.g. HK.TCH260629C470000.

params.name: query_time_period
params.description: Query time period, default 2. 1=1 week, 2=1 month, 3=3 months, 4=6 months, 5=1 year. See Naming Dictionary.

params.name: hv_time_period
params.description: Historical volatility period (calendar days), default 30, range 5~250.

title: Owner Plate
description: Get the industry / concept sectors (plates) that a stock belongs to.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

title: Reference Future
description: Get reference future contract information for a symbol.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, typically a futures front-month/continuous contract (e.g. HK.HSImain, US.CLmain, SG.NKmain). Non-futures symbols are valid but return an empty list.

title: Analyst Consensus
description: Get the analyst consensus rating and target price for a stock (composite rating, number of covering analysts, rating tier proportions, target price range).

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

title: Morningstar Report
description: Get the Morningstar comprehensive rating report for a stock, including star rating, fair value, economic moat, uncertainty, capital allocation, financial health and other core ratings, as well as analyst text commentary for each dimension.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

title: Rating Summary
description: Get the analyst rating summary for a stock, providing per-institution / per-analyst rating details (rating, target price, recommendation date, report link). Supports institution-level and analyst-level views.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. US.AAPL (only US/CA stocks have data).

params.name: rating_dimension_type
params.description: Rating dimension. 1=Institution (default), 2=Analyst.

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor; leave empty for the first page.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size. Default 10, max 20.

title: Real-time Data
description: Get intraday time-sharing data for a symbol. Supports NORMAL (default; HK automatically includes dark pool) / FULL (complete including pre/post market, US only) / PREMARKET / AFTERHOURS (US pre/post market) / HK_DARK (HK dark pool) / OVERNIGHT (night session). Current day trading sessions only, no cross-day history.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, format {market}.{code}, e.g. HK.00700.

params.name: request_section
params.description: Trading session, default NORMAL. See request_section enum table below.

title: Real-time Ticker
description: Get tick-by-tick trade data for a symbol. Returns the latest N trade details, including price, volume, buy/sell direction, trade type and session.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

params.name: num
params.description: Number of ticks to return, default 500, range 1~750.

params.name: period
params.description: Filter by session; pass multiple values with the same key, e.g. ?period=BEFORE&period=AFTER; omit for all sessions. See enum period_type.

title: Holder Detail
description: Get the shareholder holding detail list for a stock, with filtering by holder type / reporting period / holder ID, and sorting by shares held or change amount.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

params.name: request_type
params.description: Holder type filter. Default 1000 (all). See Naming Dictionary.

params.name: period_id
params.description: Reporting period ID filter. Default 0 (latest).

params.name: holder_id
params.description: Filter by holder ID. Default 0 (no filter).

params.name: sort_column
params.description: Sort column. Default 61. 61=shares held, 62=shares change.

params.name: sort_type
params.description: Sort direction. 0=descending (default), 1=ascending.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size. Default 10, max 50.

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor; leave empty for the first page.

title: Holding Changes
description: Get the shareholder holding change records for a security, with filtering by increase/decrease direction, multi-dimensional sorting, and pagination.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size. Default 30, max 50.

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor; leave empty for the first page.

params.name: sort_column
params.description: Sort column. Default 1. 1=change amount, 2=holding date, 3=change ratio, 4=change value, 5=holding ratio.

params.name: sort_type
params.description: Sort direction. Default 0. 0=descending, 1=ascending.

params.name: filter_type
params.description: Increase/decrease filter. Default 0. 0=no filter, 1=increase, 2=decrease, 3=new position, 4=full exit.

params.name: holder_category
params.description: Holder scope. Default INSTITUTIONS. Options: INSTITUTIONS / INDIVIDUALS / CORPORATIONS / ALL.

title: Insider Holders
description: Get the insider (directors / executives) holding list and summary statistics for a company.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. US.AAPL.

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor; leave empty for the first page.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size. Default 10, max 30.

title: Insider Trades
description: Get insider (directors, executives, 5%+ shareholders) trading records. Data is based on US SEC insider filings (Form 3/4/144).

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. US.AAPL.

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor; leave empty for the first page.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size. Default 10, max 50.

params.name: holder_id
params.description: Filter by insider ID. 0=no filter (default).

title: Institutional Shareholders
description: Get the institutional holding summary (aggregated by reporting period) for a stock, returning institution count, total holdings and ratio with period-over-period changes, along with reporting period close/open/previous close prices.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of reporting periods per page. Default 10, max 50.

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor; leave empty for the first page.

title: Shareholders Overview
description: Get the shareholder holding overview for a company. Returns the top 5 shareholders, holder type distribution percentages, and available holding period list.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Security code, e.g. HK.00700.

params.name: period_id
params.description: Holding period ID. Default 0 (latest period).

title: Daily Short Volume
description: Get daily short selling trade data for a symbol, sorted by date from newest to oldest. HK returns trade-level short data (short selling turnover, daily average ratio, etc.). US returns position-level short data (total short shares, Nasdaq/NYSE short shares, short ratio, etc.).

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700 or US.AAPL.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of records. Default 30, max 90.

title: Short Interest
description: Get short interest data for a stock (HK / US). Data is returned sorted by trading day from newest to oldest. HK returns short position details (outstanding short shares, percentage of float). US returns monthly short reports (short shares, short ratio, days to cover).

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700 or US.AAPL.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of records. Default 30, max 90.

title: Top Buy/Sell Brokers
description: Get the top 10 buy/sell brokers for HK stocks, split into net buy and net sell groups. Provides both real-time and historical dimensions.

params.name: symbol
params.description: HK stock code, e.g. HK.00700.

params.name: date
params.description: Trading date to query (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to latest trading day.

params.name: days_before
params.description: Number of days before current trading day, range 1-365.

title: Valuation Detail
description: Get valuation metrics (PE/PB/PS) and historical trend for a stock or index. Stocks return full valuation (trend + market distribution + plate distribution + profit growth rate); indices return trend + constituent valuation distribution.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Symbol code, e.g. HK.00700 (stock) or HK.800700 (index).

params.name: valuation_type
params.description: Valuation type. Default 1. 1=PE, 2=PB, 3=PS.

params.name: interval_type
params.description: Time span. Default 3. 1=3 months, 2=6 months, 3=1 year, 4=3 years, 5=Since May 2019, 6=5 years, 7=10 years, 8=2 years, 9=20 years, 10=30 years.

title: Account List
description: Get the list of simulated trading accounts for the current logged-in user. Accounts are automatically created on the first call. The returned account_id is used as a path parameter for all subsequent trading endpoints.

title: Account Cash Info
description: Get account cash/asset information (balance, frozen amount, buying power, market value, P&L).

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Business account ID

title: History Orders
description: Get historical orders (supports time range + pagination).

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Business account ID

params.name: time_begin
params.description: Start time (microseconds)

params.name: time_end
params.description: End time (microseconds)

params.name: page_size
params.description: Page size (default 50)

params.name: next_key
params.description: Pagination cursor

title: Max Buy/Sell Quantity
description: Query the maximum buy/sell quantity for a security.

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Business account ID

params.name: symbol
params.description: Security symbol

params.name: order_type
params.description: 1=Limit 3=Market

params.name: price
params.description: Price (required for limit orders)

params.name: order_id
params.description: Original order ID (for modification)

title: Today's Orders
description: Get today's order list.

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Business account ID

description: Place a simulated trade order. Limit orders require a price; orders priced above market price are filled immediately. HK stock quantities must be multiples of the board lot size.

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Business account ID

params.name: market
params.description: Market (from market_id in account list)

params.name: symbol
params.description: Security symbol

params.name: order_type
params.description: 1=Limit 3=Market

params.name: order_side
params.description: 1=Buy 2=Sell 3=Short Sell 4=Buy Back

params.name: qty
params.description: Quantity

params.name: price
params.description: Price (required for limit orders)

params.name: text
params.description: Remark (≤100 bytes)

title: Cancel Order
description: Cancel an unfilled order. Only orders with status=2 (Submitted) can be cancelled.

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Business account ID

params.name: order_id
params.description: Order ID to cancel

title: Modify Order
description: Modify the quantity or price of an unfilled order. Only orders with status=2 (Submitted) can be modified.

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Business account ID

params.name: order_id
params.description: Original order ID

params.name: new_qty
params.description: New quantity (must be a multiple of board lot)

params.name: new_price
params.description: New price

title: Position List
description: Get the position list (symbol, direction, quantity, cost, market value, P&L).

params.name: acc_id
params.description: Business account ID

params.name: market
params.description: Market filter
